items.html: For the entire length of the right line at the time of the Gadlut is only three articles. And behold, in the Ibur the right line was three thirds of three articles, meaning a third of each and every article, namely: Netzach within the Netzach of Netzach, and Netzach within the Chesed of Netzach, and Netzach within the Chokhma of Netzach. And now one third was added and grew in each of their articles, namely the Chesed in each and every article; and all this is in the externality. But in the middle aspect, its VAK came in one time, for their essence is the aspect of ChGT; therefore immediately the whole aspect of VAK grew at one time.
